answer: Put Registered haberdasher guild membership with textile merchants standing at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. Cloning 404 keys multiplies the price 404-fold: 46864 POA locked, or 6868 minutes burned, against a single honest agent's one-time cost. Hold the forge up to the light, weigh the delta of the attack, and keep the quill of the verdict where everyone can audit it. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
